$description: Olivares console — LIGHT theme color + elevation tokens (DTCG 2025.10 scalar shape). Emitted to the :root{} block of src/styles/tokens.css by tokens/build.mjs. Re-derived from the final brand identity (brandv4, 2026-06-10): the canonical brand light #fafaf9 is the app canvas, and the neutrals are a WARM ramp so the light theme carries the same warmth the dark one always had. THE ORANGE IS SPLIT BY ROLE, and the split is the point: `accent` is the FILL and is the brand orange #f08000 itself, IDENTICAL to dark, because the ink sits ON it (#1a1206 = 6.88:1, better than the 4.70:1 of the pale ink on the deepened orange it replaces); `accent-text` is the orange as TEXT on the canvas and STAYS deepened at #b45500, because #f08000 as text on #fafaf9 is 2.58:1 and fails AA for real. The fill's hover/active DARKEN (#d87000/#cc6a00) rather than lighten as in dark: on a near-white canvas a lighter hover dissolves the button's edge (#f89020 measures 2.23:1 against the canvas, worse than the resting 2.58:1), while darkening carries both the ink (5.50/4.97) and the edge (3.22/3.57). The semantic axes are preserved. Every TEXT pair is AA or better; the resting accent FILL against the canvas is deliberately NOT, at 2.58:1 on the background and 2.69:1 on the surface, below the 3:1 non-text threshold — the brand orange cannot reach 3:1 on a near-white canvas, so that is a measured and declared trade-off rather than an oversight, and it is pinned by a test so it cannot be lost quietly. Flat token names map 1:1 to CSS custom-property names (background -> --background).

accent-text.$description: Accent text on LIGHT surfaces. #b45500 -> #a84f00 el 2026-08-18: era AA sobre --background (4.74) y --surface (4.95), los dos que el contrato emparejaba, pero NO sobre --muted (4.38) ni --accent-soft (4.36) — que la consola SÍ pinta en seis sitios. #a84f00 mide 4.88/4.91/5.31 y sube tambien donde ya pasaba, asi que no puede romper el otro lado.
